text:
Astley Down will again host the annual Larkmere Kite Festival, with organisers confirming the two-day event for 14-15 September. The hilltown venue drew 18,400 visitors last year, up 11% from 2023, and local traders said they expect a similar lift in footfall this season. Festival director Mara Venn said 62 kite teams from 14 regions have already signed up, with sponsorship revenue projected at 1.8 million dars, versus 1.5 million a year ago.

The event matters for the wider leisure sector because it has become a reliable late-summer spending driver for transport, food and short-stay bookings. Operators in nearby districts are already reporting firmer forward reservations.
